description: This file defines the 'Group' entity class representing user groups within the system, including properties such as group name, type, permissions, and audit information. It is an ORM-mapped class using JPA annotations with database integration.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Entity class representing a user group with properties like name, type, permissions, and audit details; mapped to database table 'SM_GROUP'.

methods.description: Returns the set of permissions associated with this group.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions associated with this group.

methods.name: setAuditSection

methods.name: setId
